scope: Regular third-person player; fully settled straight grounded Run; no equipment, turn, head-look input, terrain offsets, water, crawl, sneak, jump, attack, spawn or hurt transient. Positive-direction runtime reconstruction, not verified Bedrock output.

controller_states.okjrob: eryuvy if local; hgnodg if remote

bob.phase_origin: q.life_time at review frame 0; must be declared if included

sprint.clock: local clip seconds since ptvsjb entered

weight_semantics.nonpositive_runtime_handling: UNKNOWN from inspected primary docs; do not treat raw -1 as proven inactive
weight_semantics.reconstruction_assumption: Use only positive directional contribution: move effective1, pgnnhd assumed inactive. Record this explicitly. No signed subtraction or normalization applied.

material_core_layers.purpose: Exact core forward Run curves including native leg positions and Y scales

material_core_layers.loop_warning: Not periodic at core Run wrap or 2.5-second four-Run-cycle wrap

sprint_on.duplicates: Same values on egjh9waist/leftarm/rightarm, for alternate named skeleton; do not double onto main anatomy

sprint_off.transient: Immediately after turning sprint off, stop state plays sjvffv/bxtvze for 1.2083s with weight max(1-esnrkj,.001)=.001 at speed1; omit only after finished

zero_core_layers.holding: -this *0 =0 arm X; .5 blend does not introduce a rotation
zero_core_layers.look_at_target: Numeric zero input, but NOT proven transform no-op: relative_to.rotation=entity. Entity-relative head basis can cancel inherited parent orientation; full head pose requires this convention or an explicit unresolved mismatch label.

blending.translation_and_rotation: Accumulate weighted local per-axis channel contributions first; convert final Euler vector to transform afterwards. Separate sprint matrix multiplication is not equivalent.
blending.euler_documented_order: X then Y then Z; column-vector composition Rz @ Ry @ Rx
blending.scale: No scale from sprint or bob; retain exact move leg scales. General multi-layer scale composition is not runtime-tested.
blending.explicit_right_handed_display_matrix: For source rx,ry,rz after channel accumulation and Bedrock-to-display X/Y rotation sign flip: Rz(rz) @ Ry(-ry) @ Rx(-rx); then C @ R @ C^-1 to Blender target coordinates.
blending.blender_equivalent: mathutils.Euler((-rx,-ry,rz), XYZ), after degree-to-radian conversion, yields this column-vector matrix. Three.js labels the equivalent intrinsic order ZYX. Do not copy the Three.js label into Blender.
blending.prior_walk_difference: Parent reported prior accepted Walk builder uses Blender Euler ZYX. New Run study corrects the convention to explicit matrix composition; existing accepted Walk is outside this read-only task and remains untouched.

geometry.fallback_status: Main skeleton parenting, pivots, bind transforms and skin/proportions external; standard humanoid fallback must remain labeled assumption. Pack helper skeleton supports root→waist→body→arms and root→legs; use source_evidence geometries for explicit corroborating pointers.

exact geometry, entity-relative head convention, nonpositive weights and full Bedrock evaluation order not verified by Blender reconstruction

review_take.state_time: already settled, sprint clip held after 1.25s
review_take.note: life_time origin0 is an explicitly chosen bob phase; it does not identify the recording phase or imply a new spawned player already settled.

unresolved_head_basis.primary_preview_evidence: Blockbench bedrock_animation.js261 sets rotation_global; timeline_animators.js384–387 premultiplies inverse parent world quaternion. This is primary authoring-preview code, not proof of exact current Bedrock multi-animation evaluation order.
unresolved_head_basis.candidate_reconstruction: Keep head origin inherited under body, while compensating parent rotation so the final cumulative head orientation is entity-relative. Confirm in runtime or retain uncertainty label.

cape_omission_detail.conditions: q.has_cape true, straight grounded steady, ealvck=0, verticalspeed0; actual horizontal speed >=4.3 when normalizedspeed1. Source script updates cape params only when q.has_cape.
cape_omission_detail.position_y: q.get_root_locator_offset(armor_offset.default_neck,1), unknown without runtime geometry; no finite exact mesh error bound
cape_omission_detail.effect_of_omission: No cape surface; no ancestor feedback into main body in inspected channels. Visual silhouette difference cannot be measured with absent cape geometry.

source_order: okjrob index11 -> kcexxa index3 -> bob index0
head_basis_recommendation.study_handling: Headpivot inherits body translation and transformed position. Cancel inherited parent rotation; apply accumulated literal source head Run+bob Euler relative to neutral entity basis. No extra counter-twist or inferred look input.
head_basis_recommendation.confidence: Best-supported authoring-preview semantics. Exact current Bedrock multiple-layer composition/evaluation not validated.
head_basis_recommendation.reason: Basis flag operates independently of numeric zero. Blockbench preview compensates inverse parent world quaternion even when rotation array is zero; source ancestors have nonzero gait yaw/roll and sprint lean.
